title: Verse Estate allows users to buy properties linked to an NFT
htmlContent:
Verse Estate, the first real estate agency in the Metaverse, has launched its platform. Verse Estate aims to bridge the physical and digital worlds by providing hyper-realistic and fully customizable luxury products in the Metaverse. As a real estate agency in the Metaverse, Verse Estate allows users to buy properties linked to an NFT. The NFT acts as a digital key to the owner's private luxury estate, where they can display their digital assets on the walls, invite up to 100 friends, stream Netflix on their TV, and for the first time, users can even play VR Games without ever leaving their estate. They also help brands and celebrities transition to the Metaverse by creating state-of-the-art immersive experiences, bringing the user experience to a new level.

Verse Estate has set the bar high in the Metaverse world with exceptional customer service, they don't just sell NFTs, but they accompany the users every step to maximize their comfort in their journey with Verse Estate. Users can explore properties bought on Verse Estate through the Oculus Quest 2 VR headsets. Users can directly access the app through the Oculus store.
